content.title: Clean up 50 leaked UrlFilter E2E seed issues and harden isolation to prevent recurrence
content.description:
The real agentrack tracker has been polluted with 50 stray issues created by the E2E seedIssues helper in packages webApp e2e url-filters-validation spec. They were assigned to webapp-validator with empty descriptions and the title pattern UrlFilter Status dash timestamp dash random.

Scope of pollution (verified 2026-06-16):
- 50 issues total: 8 todo, 8 in-progress, 8 idea, 8 done, 18 closed.
- 24 are in non-terminal states and pollute the Open, Idea, Todo, and In-progress dashboards.
- They cluster into 10 seedIssues batches by timestamp stamp (e.g. uz574m, tcsjzj, 1yg76g, v78324, brvgt2, l5r9qj, yvvq7e, eo4h4l, 71r20j, 6h9846).

Two work items:

1. Bulk cleanup. Close or delete the 50 leaked issues. The 24 non-terminal ones are highest priority because they appear on active dashboards. A safe heuristic for identifying them: title matches regex UrlFilter prefix (Idea or Todo or InProgress or Done or Closed) followed by dash, no parent, empty description, no tags. Note: the originally-assigned issue mqh0lg9d2i is one of these 50.

2. Root-cause guard. The current playwright config spawns its own backend with AGENTRACK CWD pointed at the isolated e2e data dir and does not set reuseExistingServer, which is correct. The leak most likely happened when a manually-started dev server was already bound to port 3001 without the AGENTRACK CWD env var, OR from an older config revision. Options to prevent recurrence:
   - Add a startup assertion in global-setup that the running backend resolves AGENTRACK CWD to the e2e data dir (e.g. GET a health or config endpoint that echoes the cwd) and fail the run otherwise.
   - Have seedIssues create issues with a recognizable tag (e.g. e2e-seed) and a cleanup afterEach that deletes them, so leaked seeds are self-healing.
   - Document in the e2e README that nothing should ever bind port 3001 manually while tests run.

This is idea status for manager triage.

content.content: Triaged (ideas loop). Non-duplicate: prior E2E-isolation work (dedicated test ports, isolated e2e data dir) exists but the leak recurred and is now broader (~200 leaked seed issues across url-filters, comments, blockages, parent/tag, and search E2E specs, not just the 50 UrlFilter ones noted). Created by a worker (webapp-validator), not a manager, so routed for review rather than auto-accepted. Routed to library-architect (building team's architect): this is a platform/tooling request from a consumer (webapp e2e) about the agentrack CLI's AGENTRACK_CWD resolution, so the building team's architect owns the design decision. Review task mqh1ghz42s + gate tracker mqh1gpnqjp (blocked by review) created. Idea set in-progress, assigned to PM. Note: the ~200 other idea-status issues in the tracker are the leaked E2E seed data themselves (empty descriptions, machine-generated timestamped titles) -- they are not real ideas and fall within the cleanup scope of this very idea, so they are not separately triaged.

Audit: deleted leaked seed issue mqh0lhzldz (stamp l5r9qj, batch UrlFilterTodo-1781636877998). It was routed to me inline via the work loop (reassigned by webapp-validator who correctly identified it). Matches the leak signature exactly: title matches UrlFilter+Status+timestamp+random, no parent, empty description, no tags, createdBy anonymous, status todo. Deletion authorized by accepted review mqh1ghz42s (Work Item 1). The remaining ~199 seeds will be swept by the bulk cleanup task; recording this one-off deletion here for audit completeness.

Cleanup performed: deleted all leaked E2E test pollution from the real tracker — 388 test issues (UrlFilter*, Phase2 Test, SearchTest, CaseTest, NavTest, Comment/Blockage/History/Timeline tests, parent/clear/tag tests, etc., plus their 26 children) and revoked 27 timestamped test users. The tracker now holds only 114 real issues across 26 top-level deliverables and the 9 real team members. No orphaned blockages remain. The hardening part (preventing the webapp validator from re-polluting) is still the open deliverable under this chore.

Accepted (ideas loop, gate mqh1gpnqjp cleared). Library-architect review mqh1ghz42s = ACCEPT with refinements.

STATUS:
- Work Item 1 (bulk cleanup): COMPLETE. Tracker swept on 2026-06-16 — 388 leaked seed issues + 26 children + 27 test users removed; 114 real issues remain across 26 top-level deliverables. Audited above. No further cleanup work.
- Work Item 2 (harden E2E isolation): REMAINING. This is now the active scope of this chore.

Hardening scope (from the accepted review):
- Layer A (mandatory): health endpoint echoes resolved cwd (or a test-only debug route does); global-setup.ts asserts the returned path equals the e2e data dir and fails the run otherwise. Directly catches a non-isolated server on port 3001.
- Layer B (mandatory): every e2e seed-creation call site tags issues with 'e2e-seed' and captures ids; a shared afterEach/afterAll in setup.ts lists+deletes tagged seeds so the suite is self-healing.
- Layer C (mandatory): README section documenting the isolation invariants (never manually bind 3001, never set reuseExistingServer, AGENTRACK_CWD is the isolation boundary, ports 3001/5174 must stay distinct from 3000/5173).

Invariants to preserve: AGENTRACK_CWD name unchanged; reuseExistingServer stays absent on both webServer entries; ports 3001/5174 stay distinct.

Created phase tasks: Plan -> Dev -> Validate. Idea retagged chore. Internal test-infrastructure work, so it completes at Validate (no separate release).
